input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: build an X.509 certificate chain checker (no venture read certificates before)

errors.what: run_workflow_locally --for-changes failed twice on first pass: post description 171 chars (limit 160) and sibling-links orphan budget 0 for the new venture
errors.fix: shortened description; added a footer link and test in caa-record-check

doc_friction.issue: Lists sweeps already done but not the sibling-link orphan gate (platform/pages/siblings.mjs) every new venture must satisfy; I only learned it from the local CI run. A one-line 'a new venture needs a sibling linking it' would save a cycle.
Runs check_posts.py only via the unwired checks in the full workflow run, so a per-venture run passes while the post fails; noted in its own output, but easy to miss.

notes: Explore idea: cert-chain-check, an in-browser + Node CLI X.509 chain checker (own DER/X.509 reader, Web Crypto signature checks, chain building by name+AKI/SKI, browser hostname rules, CA/B SC-081v3 validity schedule, fixed fullchain output). Parity vs OpenSSL 3.0.13: 15 fields x 37 generated certs match openssl x509; every openssl verify error on 30 chains matched by a same-fault finding and none extra where verify passes; 25 host checks agree except 2 named browser differences (CN fallback, partial wildcard); all 120 Ubuntu roots read identically and 120/120 self-signatures verify. Finding: openssl reports a re-keyed same-name issuer as error 20 (missing issuer), so the checker names that near miss. No live public chain checked. Local checks: run_venture_tests (2 suites ok), check_posts ok, siblings ok, Chromium page drive ok. No agent doc in docs/reports: nothing the next run needs beyond the README.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: DER/X.509 parser, chain builder, WebCrypto verify, OpenSSL fixture generator and parity tests, two pages, CLI, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
